Likely needs the SAME "wrap in a freshly-declared closure" treatment applied at the `Expr::Var` reference site too, not just at the lambda-construction site — i.e. detect when an `onSubmit`/`HtmlEventShape::Raw` payload resolves to a `Var` referencing an already-boxed value and re-wrap there as well.

NOT investigated beyond confirming the diagnostic and root-causing it to arity, not Sync.
